title: Parent-type first collisions EE, EO, OE, OO form a new seam
statement: Classifying T_u(n)=T_v(m)=x with no earlier shared state by the last-letter parent types EE, EO, OE, OO produces a fibre, emptiness, or word-pair restriction that is not odd_preimage_unique / oddLanding_preimage_unique / even_preimage_iff / shared-tail determinism / trailing-EE count n(n^2+n+1) / twin-flight sink convention / NC inversion.
counterexamples: off {1,2}, first collision iff last parents differ (9375 itinerary meetings, |u|,|v|<=3, starts <=400)
odd_preimage_unique / oddLanding_preimage_unique: OO first meetings are empty
OE/EO one-step counts equal |Pred_O|*|Pred_E| (4288 each on x in [3,400]); witness 5 -O-> 11 <-E- 122
EE one-step count equals P(P-1) for P=|Pred_E| (21413594 on the same window); witness 100 -> 10 <- 102
4 -EEO-> 1 <-E- 2 has distinct last parents after the orbits already joined; sink overshoot along 2->1->1, not a new type
notes: Phase 0 only. Not a reopen of the first-intersection / cyclic-seam / entry-corridor / seam-sliding / seam-propagate leftover-killers, not twin-flight, not a predecessor BFS. The four-type table is a REPARAMETERIZATION of the one-step cells plus determinism. No finance, no N0 raise, no Paper A edit, no ledger row, no new Lean. Not a halt theorem.
tested_range: one-step parent census on x<=400 excluding sink {1,2}; itinerary pairs 1<=|u|,|v|<=3 and starts <=400
